court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Family Court, Tirunelveli (H.M.O.P.No.176 of 2020 and H.M.O.P.No.253 of 2020)
facts_of_case: Subbulakshmi got married to Durai Sivakumar on 08.09.2019. She left the matrimonial home in January 2020 due to alleged cruelty. Durai Sivakumar filed for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) of Hindu Marriage Act, while Subbulakshmi sought restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: Whenever an apparent inconsistency appears between two statutory provisions, the court should harmonize and resolve it.
legal_principles.held: It is well settled that whenever such inconsistency appears, it should be the function of the Court to harmonize the same and resolve that.
cited_cases: Shivram Dodanna Shetty v Sharmila Shivram Shetty, (2016) CTC 772

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider the scheme of both enactments and the purpose behind amending the provisions when resolving an apparent inconsistency.
legal_principles.held: Considering the scheme of both the enactments and the purpose behind amending the provisions of section 28(4) of the Act of 1955, it would not be appropriate to apply different period of limitation...
cited_cases: Shivram Dodanna Shetty v Sharmila Shivram Shetty, (2016) CTC 772

outcome.final_order: The Family Judge's order dated 04.02.2022 allowing divorce and dismissing restitution of conjugal rights was set aside.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Section 19 of Family Courts Act
advising on annulment of voidable marriage
